summary: json-schema-inspector fetches and executes remote encrypted payloads on API use
details: The package presents itself as a JSON/XML schema validator but its exported validateJson/validateXml functions invoke a hidden loader in lib/core.js that (1) XOR-decodes a hardcoded hex-encoded C2 manifest URL pointing at cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/cryptonomad411/cool-utils/package.json, (2) fetches the manifest and selects a per-OS/arch payload URL, and (3) AES-256-CBC-decrypts a bundled per-platform loader script and spawns it detached via node -e on Windows or sh -c on Linux/macOS to fetch and run the remote payload. Execution is gated behind sandbox-evasion checks (os.uptime<300s, cpus<2, totalmem<2GB) at lib/core.js around lines 7/90/107. The C2 URL and each per-OS loader are stored as ciphertext and decrypted at runtime by helpers.aesDecrypt with an arithmetic-derived key; commented-out checks against ~/.ssh/id_rsa, ~/.bash_history, and VBox/VMware markers indicate deliberate host targeting. The behavior has no relation to schema validation.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
